**Finding: T4C — compliant (sits at/above fallback).**

- **Customer convenience right:** § 14 (p0079) lets Client terminate on an unconditional written "election to terminate," with services running only to the last day of the month following the notice month — a ~30–60 day exit, inside the 60–90 day fallback window and close to the 30-day preferred standard.
- **No early-termination fee:** nothing in § 5/§ 6 or elsewhere imposes a penalty or accelerated minimum on that election, so the three-month cap is comfortably satisfied.
- **Vendor side:** TrueLink has no mid-term convenience right. The only Vendor exit is the 30-day notice of intent not to renew at the end of each one-year period (p0078), expressly tied to term end — a RENEWAL item, not T4C; the § 2/§ 3 cut-offs there are cause-based. Term is one year, so the multi-year walk-away test is not engaged.
- **Noted, not flagged:** no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees (fees are billed monthly in arrears, so nothing is prepaid), and the run-off can exceed 30 days. Also flagged for internal follow-up: § 14 is "Subject to Section 4," and Section 4 is not in the supplied text — worth confirming it holds no minimum-commitment or acceleration mechanic.

No redline proposed.
